best_plan_rationale: GEMINI posts the highest raw number (59.20 recomputed) — this is flagged openly rather than buried — but it is not adoptable as written. Two-thirds of its margin comes from captaining Bogle, a single-GW xPts spike on a £4.5m defender, and CLAUDE.md's captaincy section is LOCKED: floor/matchup/form/venue/single-GW-xPts were all tested across 7 holdout rounds and none beat the cum_pts-leader rule. sim-lab's trigger audit cleared NOTHING. The rest of its margin comes from starting Gakpo at 75% fitness, which fails Consistency Rule (A). GEMINI also cannot count: its own report says 41.17, five starters short. CLAUDE's 52.80 is complete, verified, protocol-compliant, risk-gated, and beats YOUR real squad by +2.64 xPts before counting the un-priced vice-captain and EO risk it removes. Best plan = CLAUDE, with one idea imported from GEMINI (see highest_leverage_action follow-ups).
verdict: YOUR CURRENT TEAM NEEDS A MOVE — but not a transfer, and not the armband. You already match the best plan where it matters most: captain Haaland is correct and is confirmed by CLAUDE, sim-lab, intel and the-rival (4 independent voices; the model's 3.75 xPts is fixture-suppressed, not ceiling-suppressed, and fading a ~111% EO armband was proven negative-EV in the 25/26 backtest). What does not match is your lineup: you are starting Wissa (2.10) over João Pedro (4.11, ~72% owned, home to the league's worst xG side) and M.Sangaré (1.85) over Egan (4.08), and your insurance policy is a 75%-doubtful Gakpo. Those are three FREE fixes worth roughly +6.5 xPts combined — they take your 50.15 to ~56.7 with zero transfers, zero hits and zero chips. ENGINE DISAGREEMENT FLAGGED: GEMINI wants the armband on Bogle, CLAUDE keeps it on Haaland — conviction is SPLIT, so the tiebreak falls to the locked protocol and to the-rival, both of which side with Haaland. Do not chase Bogle with the captaincy; a 48-pt mini-league gap over 35 GWs is ~1.4/GW, a compounding problem, not a coinflip problem. Chips: all three plans say HOLD (TC, FH, WC×1) — unanimous, no action.
